_comment: Source of truth for the docker-on-tag workflow. A git tag `docker-<key>-v<version>` builds and pushes that app's image to ECR (repo name == `ecr`). `lang` routes to the TS (turbo/bun) or Rust (cargo) build path. `scope` is the turbo/cargo package filter; `out` + `start` describe the built artifact for TS apps; `bin` is the cargo binary for Rust apps.
